links.comparator_used: Out-of-the-box inference of the SEED-trained classifier on external (EXT) data without retraining
links.outcome: Classification performance on external data (% extreme misclassifications) and repeatability
links.effect: Strong classification performance on EXT achieved with retraining: 4.0% extreme misclassifications with n = 26 EXT individuals added to SEED (2n normal : 2n indeterminate : n precancer+), with incremental improvement as images from more individuals were added. Repeatability (95% limit of agreement range 0.2-0.4) carried over to EXT even without retraining.
links.tradeoff: Retraining needs images from new individuals in the new setting. Device-level heterogeneity affected performance more than geography-level heterogeneity, so retraining needs to be optimized, e.g. when moving to a new device.
links.quote: Our results indicate strong repeatability of our multiclass model utilizing Monte-Carlo (MC) dropout, which carries over well to “EXT” (95% limit of agreement range = 0.2 - 0.4) even in the absence of retraining, as well as strong classification performance of our model on “EXT” that is achieved with retraining (% extreme misclassifications = 4.0% for n = 26 “EXT” individuals added to “SEED” in a 2n normal : 2n indeterminate : n precancer+ ratio), and incremental improvement of performance following retraining with images from additional individuals.

design_hint: local retraining/recalibration on external site data before deployment
